fusions.name: Notch and Fell
fusions.desc: A falling chop on a target at or below 30% health that deals 22 damage, uses up every affliction on it and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Hatchet Chaser
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet and a small blade together out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage and leaving its target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scored for the Split
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
